scope: Read-only source/authorization safety review; Cleanup class not executed, no lifecycle operation.
reviewer_boundary: Implementation agent second review, not independent human approval or a replacement for root preflight/receipt.
confirmed_boundaries: Default only prints contract; --preflight is read-only, --execute additionally needs successful root daily deployment/current-ID/readback/task receipt.
Every mutation rechecks window/plan/grant/receipt hashes and exact approved identity; protected current daily/hardened/recovery objects remain excluded.
Full batch preflight manifest is saved before the first stop/removal; every removal repeats static identity/labels/image/created/mount checks and references.
Mount order is compared by destination; only newly exposed Driver=local on a volume may be omitted. All originally recorded fields and every other actual field remain strict.

Only exact approved synthetic containers may stop then non-force rm; no -v or anonymous volume cleanup. Networks require exact ID and no active/declared refs. Named volumes require local driver/metadata and zero global-container refs.
No image lifecycle, prune, down, network disconnect or filesystem-delete operation exists. Unknown/missing/drift/rollback-protected objects skip and remain retained.
Post-removal absence and retained-object static metadata are checked; counters and all_approved_objects_removed are explicit.
limitations: Root receipt booleans assert actual successful prerequisite work; the cleanup tool does not independently re-run private business readback or Windows scheduler installation.

Volume APIs identify a name rather than immutable UUID. Fresh metadata/reference check followed by non-force rm cannot create a cross-command atomic compare-and-delete; exclusive Trip window and no concurrent same-name lifecycle remain required.
passed denotes safe completion and can include retained skips. Do not infer all53 removals from passed alone; inspect removed_counts, skips, all_approved_objects_removed and absence receipts.
Read-only source review does not replace the actual just-before-removal preflight or grant further scope.
